# @effected/env

Effect-native environment detection for any front end of a tool: which agent or CI is running the program, what the terminal can do (colour level, hyperlinks, columns), and which audience the output is for. Everything is read once through `Config` and swapped in tests with `layerTest`.

> **Pre-release.** Part of the `@effected/*` kit, in pre-`1.0.0` development. The API is unstable and may change across `0.x` releases.

## Install

```bash
npm install @effected/env effect
```

```bash
pnpm add @effected/env effect
```

## API

The API is documented at the website.
